data.name: Bangaram
data.gender_notes: Bangaram is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Bangaram is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘bangara,’ meaning ‘auspicious,’ ‘blessed.’ This name is often given to a boy as a mark of good fortune and blessings. The name Bangaram carries the meaning “Blessing, Auspicious” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Bangaram usually hope their child will grow to embody blessing, auspicious and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Bestowed with blessings and good fortune
data.etymology: Bangaram belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Blessing, Auspicious.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Bangaram total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
